The '''Battle of Ogoth Tiir''' was the final battle of the [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] [[Western Reaches Operation]], commenced during the [[Reconquest of the Rim]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces killed [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Kendu Ultho]] and captured his remaining forces.<ref name="TEGtW" /> [[Jona Grumby]] was crippled during the battle.<ref name="HS&CSS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref><ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|405|Ogoth Tiir}}</ref>
